meta.title: Okafor Electrical | NICEIC electrician in Lewisham
meta.description: NICEIC approved electrician in Lewisham. Rewires, fuse board upgrades, EV chargers and EICR landlord certificates across south east London.

rationale: A trade where customers want to see what is behind the wall and what it costs, so the page reads like a local newspaper: serif headlines, ruled lines, a plain ledger of jobs, no decoration. One red spot colour works like a warning label on a fuse board, and the drawing of a consumer unit is the tool of the trade itself.

props.headline: Rewires, fuse boards and EV chargers across south east London
props.sub: Chidi Okafor has ten years in the trade. You get a written quote, tidy work and photos of everything before the walls close.

props.title: What we do

items.name: Full and partial rewires
items.description: Old wiring out, new cable in, sockets and switches replaced. Floorboards and plaster put back.

items.name: EV charger installation
items.description: A home charge point fitted on its own circuit, on the wall or the drive.

items.name: EICR landlord safety certificates
items.description: The electrical inspection report landlords need for rented homes, with any faults listed plainly.

items.name: Lighting
items.description: New fittings, spotlights, outdoor lights and dimmers.

items.name: Sockets and switches
items.description: Extra sockets, USB sockets, moved switches and replacements for cracked or loose ones.

props.note: Prices depend on the house. Each job is quoted in writing after a visit.

pairs.ask: Can I have a price before you start?
pairs.answer: Yes. We come and look, then send a clear written quote. You see what the job covers before you say yes.

pairs.ask: Will you leave the place in a state?
pairs.answer: No. We keep the work tidy and clear up as we go.

pairs.ask: How do I know what is behind the wall?
pairs.answer: We photograph everything before the walls close and send you the pictures.

pairs.ask: I rent out a flat. What do I need?
pairs.answer: An EICR, the electrical safety certificate for landlords. We inspect, test and give you the report.

props.title: Chidi Okafor, ten years in the trade
paragraphs: Okafor Electrical is a Lewisham business and Chidi does the work himself. Most customers are homeowners and landlords in south east London.
The company is NICEIC approved. That means the work is assessed against the industry rules, and you can ask to see the paperwork for your job.
Walls get closed once. Before they do, we take photographs of the cables, the joints and the new board, so there is a record for you, for the next owner and for the next electrician.
